# Universal Honeypot Benchmarking Standard (UHBS)

> Personal open-source beta framework (v4.2.1) for vendor-neutral honeypot and deception-technology evaluation using a composite UHQS score (0–100) with a non-linear Safety Gate.

UHBS is **not** an industry consortium or multi-party standards body. It is a Beta / Experimental personal project. Prefer primary sources below over third-party summaries.

## Essential

- [Home / landing](https://mziqudhd92.github.io/uhbs-standard/): Hub overview and published lab grades
- [MkDocs docs](https://mziqudhd92.github.io/uhbs-standard/mkdocs/): Spec, scorecards, reports
- [Document status](https://mziqudhd92.github.io/uhbs-standard/mkdocs/specification/status/): Beta/Experimental; UHBS-Core vs UHBS-Lab
- [Scoring formula (UHQS)](https://mziqudhd92.github.io/uhbs-standard/mkdocs/specification/scoring-formula/): Normative UHQS and δ_C Safety Gate
- [Modules A–F](https://mziqudhd92.github.io/uhbs-standard/mkdocs/specification/modules/): Evaluation module objectives
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/mziqudhd92/uhbs-standard): Source, schemas, CLI, UHBS-Lab harness

## Specification

- [Core principles](https://mziqudhd92.github.io/uhbs-standard/mkdocs/specification/core-principles/): Dual-plane audit and isolation
- [Target profiles (TPS)](https://mziqudhd92.github.io/uhbs-standard/mkdocs/specification/target-profiles/): profile.yaml classes and weights
- [CLI & validator](https://mziqudhd92.github.io/uhbs-standard/mkdocs/tooling/cli/): uhbs validate-profile / validate-scorecard / score
- [MCP server (AI hosts)](https://mziqudhd92.github.io/uhbs-standard/mkdocs/tooling/mcp/): stdio tools for Cursor / Claude / VS Code — validate, UHQS, fixtures
- [Reference implementation](https://mziqudhd92.github.io/uhbs-standard/mkdocs/reference-implementation/): uhbs_core Modules A–F harness

## Evidence & maturity

- [Conformance fixtures](https://mziqudhd92.github.io/uhbs-standard/mkdocs/conformance/): Named product proof scorecards only
- [Lab reports](https://mziqudhd92.github.io/uhbs-standard/mkdocs/conformance/reports/): Published quick+full grades (ESPot, miniprint, Conpot, Cowrie, OpenCanary)
- [Roadmap](https://mziqudhd92.github.io/uhbs-standard/mkdocs/roadmap/): Technical done vs Phase 6 community goals
- [Maintainers](https://github.com/mziqudhd92/uhbs-standard/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md): Single author today
- [Citation](https://github.com/mziqudhd92/uhbs-standard/blob/main/CITATION.cff): How to cite this beta
- [MCP server.json](https://github.com/mziqudhd92/uhbs-standard/blob/main/server.json): Registry metadata (publish after PyPI)

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](https://mziqudhd92.github.io/uhbs-standard/mkdocs/llms-full.txt): Longer curated digest for agents
- [ATT&CK / NIST / IEC mappings](https://mziqudhd92.github.io/uhbs-standard/mkdocs/mappings/): Informative interoperability notes
- [RFC-0001 baseline](https://mziqudhd92.github.io/uhbs-standard/mkdocs/rfcs/0001-uhbs-4.2.1-baseline/): Accepted v4.2.1 baseline note
- [MCP honeypot grading](https://github.com/mziqudhd92/uhbs-standard/blob/main/docs/architecture/mcp-honeypot-grading.md): Live `uhbs-lab --protocol mcp` (not AI-host MCP)
